777fd98e0c5a.title: Systems Engineering Intern
777fd98e0c5a.description_html:
We are seeking a Systems Engineering Intern in our Broomfield, CO location to join our team in Broomfield, Colorado for Summer 2027. This internship is intended for a technically strong student entering their senior year of an undergraduate program or a graduate student currently pursuing a degree in systems engineering or a related technical field.

This role is designed for an emerging systems engineer who is eager to build hands-on experience across test development, system modeling, interface definition, and/or requirements allocation for next-generation quantum computing systems.

All applicants for placement in safety-sensitive positions will be required to submit to a pre-employment drug test.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and execute tests for next-generation systems, including writing test code, building test pipelines, and documenting results Support the design, assembly, and validation of test hardware used to evaluate system performance and interfaces Create SysML models to support interface control, system architecture, and cross-functional communication Assist with requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification planning

YOU MUST HAVE:

Enrolled in a Bachelor’s, master’s or PhD Program Graduating on/after 2027 Due to Contractual requirements, must be a U.S. Person. defined as, U.S. citizen permanent resident or green card holder, workers granted asylum or refugee status Due to national security requirements imposed by the U.S. Government, candidates for this position must not be a People's Republic of China national or Russian national unless the candidate is also a U.S. citizen.

WE VALUE:

Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to work onsite at Quantinuum’s Broomfield, Colorado location during Summer 2027 Experience with Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar engineering/test automation tools Familiarity with SysML, Cameo, MagicDraw, or other modeling tools Exposure to requirements management tools or practices Coursework or project experience involving complex engineered systems, controls, embedded systems, optics, cryogenics, robotics, aerospace systems, or quantum technologies Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing.    Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore.    By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.  

What’s in it for you?

We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

  • For candidates located outside of this state, this role will include a housing stipend of $500 per check/bi-weekly 
  • A competitive market rate and innovative, game-changing work
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee discounts

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. For more information about Quantinuum, please visit our website. 

We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, there is no application deadline for this position.

77a8be42f889.title: Hardware Support & Test Intern
77a8be42f889.description_html:
Join the Sleep Fitness Movement

At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.

Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.

The opportunity

We’re looking for an intern on the hardware engineering team to troubleshoot field units and support testing of prototypes. You’ll be part of a small, mission-driven team working on novel hardware products. We’re growing quickly so there are ample opportunities for challenge and growth.

This internship starts in Fall 2026 and requires being on-site in our San Francisco office.

How you’ll contribute

  • Troubleshoot issues seen in the field by customers by analyzing data from units, talk to customers as needed to understand failures, and work with the engineering team to determine root causes and corrective actions.

  • Support product development teams with prototyping and testing.

  • Build software and AI tools to facilitate diagnosis of hardware failures.

What you need to succeed

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with mechanical, electrical, and software systems to understand possible causes of failures.

  • Familiarity with interpreting data and sensor readings.

  • Familiarity with root cause analysis, DOE, and quality measuring techniques.

  • Pursuing or recently completed a BS in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.

At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.
